playtest.finding_rear_pod: sim/systems/combat.gd:1325 sets e.facing = shot angle on EVERY shot for every unit, so a strike APC turns its whole hull toward its target; the target then sits dead ahead in the rear pod's blind arc and only the front pod can fire. The rear pod only engages while the APC drives with the target behind / on the flank (movement resets facing). Suggested CR (sim, hash-moving for matches with APCs; owner WOUND7/ORCH): skip that facing write for units with independently traversing mounts (def apc7.mounts present, or a def flag such as turret_free), so the hull keeps its heading and the rear gun covers the rear. Not sent as a formal CR yet.
playtest.infantry_regression_note: run4 infantry/vehicle groups produced fewer flashes after the line-up hp top-up was added (likely the infantry stay alive but the flow's seen-filter / 25 s window or the CN team spawn order changed targeting); investigate before rerun.
